rules: Explicit facts are copied into the semantic spec before defaults are considered.
A hard lock may be changed only for safety, impossibility, or an explicit user revision.
When two hard locks conflict, surface the conflict and preserve both until precedence or a user choice resolves it; never silently drop one.
Do not convert a body-presentation request into an anatomy change.
Do not assign social rank, sacred role, ethnicity, religion, or personality from appearance.
